Numerical reference for this independently written NumPy adapter:
TensorFlow / LiteRT reference kernels, Copyright The TensorFlow Authors,
Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE-LiteRT.txt.
Q31 multiplication and quantized mean semantics follow TensorFlow reference
algorithms. Per-channel FC rounding follows the LiteRT 2.3.0 reference kernel.
https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/v2.14.0/tensorflow/lite/kernels/internal/reference/reduce.h
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/blob/v2.3.0/tflite/kernels/internal/reference/integer_ops/fully_connected.h

This is a model-specific experimental NumPy adapter. It is not an official
TensorFlow/LiteRT distribution and does not support arbitrary TFLite models.

Validation inputs are derived from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (PhysioNet):
https://physionet.org/content/mitdb/1.0.0/
Data license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0.
Moody GB, Mark RG. The impact of the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database.
IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Magazine 20(3):45-50, 2001.
